nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza A, Influenza B, & RSV are in ‘High’ category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses (HMPV & EV-D68) remain in the ‘Low’ wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/ISOXfnlY68

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and a no significant trend over the last 3 weeks https://t.co/tiwxs3a30Q

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (51.2%) and KP.3 in light blue (7.9%) make up approximately 59% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/8YUA6zxkEL

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in ‘High’ category with high concentrations & no trend over last 3 weeks. Flu B is in seasonal onset & in ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and no trend. 68% & 56% of sites are in seasonal onset for IAV & IBV, respectively. https://t.co/lENnTfsvHt

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 26 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 7 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 4/16/25, 17 states reported infected cattle herds. Most recent wastewater detections have been in CA, IA, MD, MN, & NJ. https://t.co/PFCkOJ5Bwm

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations with no trend over the last 3 weeks. 65% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/iUtnlxsn8C

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally, but is in onset and in the ‘High’ category in some regions (West, Midwest and Northeast). 41% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV. https://t.co/K8PihjkYXR

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions except the West remain in the ‘High’ category. https://t.co/pE6bztjYBL
